I am Tanmay Chanda. I build R and Shiny applications.

I write here about the parts of that work that seem worth passing on: the
problems that were harder than they looked, and the reasons behind a
decision rather than only the decision.

My R packages:

- **rewind** - undo and redo for Shiny applications. On CRAN.
  [Documentation](https://tenmeh.github.io/rewind/) -
  [source](https://github.com/tenmeh/rewind).
- **bones** - content-shaped loading placeholders for Shiny outputs. On
  GitHub. [Documentation](https://tenmeh.github.io/bones/) -
  [source](https://github.com/tenmeh/bones).

Find me on [GitHub](https://github.com/tenmeh).

## Blogroll

- [R-bloggers](https://www.r-bloggers.com/) - a collection of blogs about

- [R Weekly](https://rweekly.org/) - a weekly list of what happened in R.
